reason: I pick dinner from a cooking video the same day, and in our house my helper runs the kitchen and the shopping, not an app. I would not scan receipts every week, and the free version already covers anything I might try.
objection: Nobody in my house would actually use it. My helper does the shopping, and I am not going to photograph receipts or keep a list updated when I just follow a video that evening.
would_change_my_mind: If my helper tried it and it saved her real time, for example by reading the receipts and reminding her in Arabic with no effort from either of us, I would pay for Plus.
